text: The contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge has been awarded to Brandt-Ueno Civil, the municipal works office confirmed on Thursday, ending a seven-month procurement process that drew bids from four regional firms. The company, a joint venture based in Lareth and Hino, will take on the 1960s span after last winter’s flood scoured its eastern approach and cracked two support pylons. Officials said the project, valued at 48.6 million dalens, is scheduled to begin in late March and reopen traffic by next autumn. For many residents, the bridge has long been more than a crossing; it is the route that ties Okarra’s market district to the grain flats beyond, and its closure has reshaped daily life.
